user_confirmed: Minimum time headway is at least 2 seconds; equality is allowed; no extra stopping while in transport.
time_grid_reason: Both maps' travel times at 2m/s are integer microseconds; maximum numerical residual before rounding is below 2e-9 microseconds. Integer comparisons avoid inconsistent equality tests after repeated floating additions.
service: Original positive equipment traversal durations are 2 seconds; original zero-service virtual/connector points remain zero.
node_reservation: All positive-service visits, including task source and task goal, reserve [arrival,arrival+2s). No endpoint query exemption. Zero-duration visits have empty occupancy.
edge_reservation: Each directed edge reserves an entrance time window [departure_of_tail,departure_of_tail+2s). This represents temporal headway, not exclusive occupancy of the entire belt.
edge_kinematics_assumptions: Same fixed speed and travel time on each directed edge; no overtaking, no entry partway along the edge, no opposite-direction shared lane inferred from graph.
motion: arrival(next) = departure(current) + travel(current,next); departure(current) = arrival(current)+service(current). All calculations on integer microsecond grid.
source: Only external holding allowed. Source arrival eligibility uses ceiling of unchanged canonical release to integer epoch. At most one new source head per second; failed predecessor at same source blocks the next item. Chronological stable source FIFO; no unseen future task may reserve resources.
ebs: Storage-out cannot be admitted before corresponding storage-in actual reported completion; no change to nominal release or STD.
business_completion: Goal physical arrival; report both continuous arrival and shared integer-epoch observation. Goal resource reservation survives business completion until its service ends.
cleanup: A committed resource interval cannot be discarded while its end is still in the future, including after goal arrival or traversal of a short edge. Whole-owner cleanup may occur no earlier than max(goal departure, last edge-entry window end), optionally rounded upward to an epoch.
comparison: Original Java HCA retained separately. Fair physical comparator explicitly labeled HCA timestamp-fixed + common headway/source/EBS adapter. Do not compare half-open candidate against closed original as if semantics were identical.
baseline_known_defects: Astar reparent changes g and parent but not t1/t2, producing implicit timing slack
original generator may admit less than one second before nominal release
original independent EBS legs can overlap and overwrite same-ID saved routes
source and goal collision checks exempt
acceptance: Independent full-population node and edge headway, route continuity, release, EBS causality and commit-order audits must pass before performance claims. Dynamic in-network next-hop replanning remains a separate implementation requirement.
